limits: The backend and PID1 aggregate workspace monitors enforce 64 MiB / 4000 entries by termination; these are not kernel filesystem quotas and transient excess is possible.
After hard backend death, independent PID1 containment ends the workload by its fixed deadline (maximum 120 seconds); this is not an immediate-on-parent-death guarantee.
Kernel, Docker daemon, filesystem-driver and hardware failure or escape resistance are outside these functional tests; no independent security audit is claimed.
Windows NVIDIA and Windows Docker engine lifecycle behavior were not tested here.
